edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient of the full balance transfer in withdraw.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in mintAWhape.
withdraw is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner to msg.sender.
block.timestamp gates sale start and reveal logic in mintAWhape.
getWhapePrice returns the salesPrice state variable.
Owner-controlled setWhapePrice writes salesPrice.
setWhapePrice is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
finalizeStartingIndex is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
reserveGiveaway is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
setProvenanceHash is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
changeBaseURI is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for authorization.
mintAWhape calls getWhapePrice to compute required payment.
mintAWhape calls getWhapeMaxAmount to bound the mint quantity.
mintAWhape performs SafeMath add/mul on supply and payment checks.
mintAWhape safely mints within a loop, invoking external receiver callbacks.
reserveGiveaway safe mints within a loop, invoking external receiver callbacks.
The external safe mint operation is performed by the _safeMint function.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received which invokes the receiver callback.
_checkOnERC721Received performs a low-level functionCall to the receiver.
Receiver callback can reenter the minting logic during safe mint.
_safeMint delegates token creation to the internal _mint function.
_mint updates the _holderTokens registry for the recipient.
_mint sets the _tokenOwners entry for the new tokenId.
_transfer clears approvals via the _tokenApprovals mapping.
mintAWhape writes startingIndexBlock once supply or reveal threshold is met.
finalizeStartingIndex writes the final startingIndex value.
finalizeStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive blockhash.
finalizeStartingIndex uses blockhash as a weak randomness source.
setProvenanceHash writes ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
setProvenanceHash flips isProvenanceSet to prevent re-setting.
startSale sets isSalePaused to false.
pauseSale sets isSalePaused to true.
mintAWhape requires isSalePaused to be false.
changeBaseURI updates the _baseURI state variable.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
numberOfWhapes parameter drives mint count validation in mintAWhape.
numberOfWhapes is used in SafeMath supply and payment computations.
newPrice parameter is assigned to salesPrice.
baseURI parameter is passed to _setBaseURI.
_hash parameter is stored as ORIGINAL_PROVENANCE.
numberOfWhapes parameter bounds the giveaway mint loop.
balance local is transferred to msg.sender in withdraw.
mintIndex local is passed to _safeMint during minting.
currentSupply local feeds the giveaway supply bound check.
index loop counter drives repeated _safeMint calls in reserveGiveaway.

normalization_plan.reason: User-supplied mint quantity parameter is only meaningful within mintAWhape validation.
Owner price parameter is directly assigned to salesPrice inside setWhapePrice.
Base URI parameter is only used to update _baseURI within changeBaseURI.
Provenance hash parameter is only stored inside setProvenanceHash.
Giveaway quantity parameter controls the mint loop in reserveGiveaway.
Local balance snapshot is used solely for the transfer in withdraw.
Local tokenId is computed and consumed only inside the mintAWhape loop.
Loop counter local belongs entirely to reserveGiveaway.
Supply snapshot local is used only for the bound check in reserveGiveaway.
